metadata.session_notes: Session 65: Completed clean architecture refactor — all implementable spec items done. 180 tests in ~4s. God classes ≤200 LoC. Singletons eliminated. GeckoAuthActivity wired to OAuthFlowCoordinator. 18 new files, 25+ modified. Remaining: device verification, MockWebServer integration tests.
